content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a way to schedule a pulse or task to occur at specific time intervals? I can create a pulse every 5 minutes, but I’d like the schedule to match the actual clock time. For example: 12:00, 12:05, 12:10, 12:15, and so on. Currently, the timer starts when the [product_name] module is powered up, so unless it boots exactly at one of these times, the intervals will be offset (e.g., 12:03, 12:08, etc.). Manually adding a large number of weekly timer blocks for each 5-minute interval isn’t practical.
You can trigger a pulse generator at 12:00 using the weekly timer. Set the pulse duration to 1/100s, with a 5-minute pause between pulses.

I'm not convinced this works as intended. Without an off timer and if it's set to run every day, each period activates. I tested this in simulation (see attached), and it ends up starting the 5-minute cycles when the [product_name] module powers up, rather than aligning exactly with the 5-minute clock intervals. If you add an off timer and latch, it will only trigger at the next scheduled time, like 12pm, which becomes a problem if the device is powered off and on at unpredictable times. If there's a built-in function for this, great—but as an alternative, maybe use a few timers set at specific intervals to reset the 5-minute pulse so that it re-syncs with the real clock (e.g., turn off at 11:59am and back on at 12pm, and repeat at 3pm, 6pm, 9pm, etc.), so it aligns every few hours at least. Does anyone have a better solution?
There is a way, but it involves using a significant number of weekly timers—specifically, you'd need 96 for full coverage, or about 8 for hourly synchronization.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are trying to schedule pulse/task intervals to match exact clock times using the [product_name] controller, but the current setup only allows timers to start from the moment the device powers up, causing a misalignment with real time after resets. Workarounds to synchronize with clock intervals involve creating many timer blocks, which users find too complex and frustrating, highlighting the lack of a straightforward scheduling option.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] controller to be able to schedule actions at fixed, clock-based intervals without needing numerous separate timers or complicated setups, regardless of when the device is powered on.
